title: Profile card
summary: Click a name in the list of the server (Tab) to see the awakened's card: level, rank, class, title, guild, stats, gear, skills and records.

blocks.text: Press Tab for the awakened of your server and click a name. The card shows the profile he plays now: his level , rank , class , title and guild , his stats , the gear he wears, the skills of his action bar and his records (monsters slain, dungeons cleared, time played...).
blocks.html: Press Tab for the awakened of your server and click a name. The card shows the profile he plays now: his level, rank, class, title and guild, his stats, the gear he wears, the skills of his action bar and his records (monsters slain, dungeons cleared, time played...).

blocks.text: In the options you can hide your gear, your stats, your skills or your records from the others: they see those parts empty. You still see your whole card.
